base_semantics_overrides: position is the occupied cell: floor(continuous center + 0.5)
pickup, contact and interaction are checked every physics frame
ghost destinations, protection and item countdowns advance only on world ticks; ghost physical centers advance on physics frames
ghost and chaser position in the base prefix are destination cells, not contact centers
an item picked up between world ticks is active immediately and first decremented on the next world tick

additional_fields.name: chaser_continuous_center
additional_fields.normalization: x/15,y/8; inactive or absent chaser is zero

rules: latest direction applies on the next physics frame, even between cell centers
movement is cardinal and body bounds cannot cross a wall or closed gate
when forward movement is fully blocked and a clear lane is within 0.4 tiles sideways, move toward that lane at normal speed before following the input direction
corner assistance validates the full sideways path and forward exit; WAIT and INTERACT do not assist, and no additional state or observation fields are required
contact uses swept circles between consecutive physics centers, including tangency; grid-cell equality is not a realtime contact criterion
ghost B has a larger contact radius to match its wider displayed body; A and C keep the original radius
rendering uses the same physical centers as contact; sprite padding, tail, hat and bobbing do not change collision bodies
new chaser contact freezes its physical center, even while the player is invincible; countdown 4 waits through the next three world ticks and resumes on the fourth
a stunned chaser finishes its interrupted cardinal segment before planning another turn
INTERACT and WAIT occupy one physics frame without translating the cat
desktop and RealtimeMansionEnv use the same RealtimeGameCore
legacy grid policies, 620-float models and v6/v7/v8 realtime models are incompatible with this contract
